metadata.name: Bengaluru area assembly constituencies and current MLAs
metadata.boundaryCaveat: DataMeet notes possible shifts and missing constituency names in its India-wide boundary dataset. Matches are approximate; verify with official election services.
metadata.attribution: Assembly constituency boundaries © DataMeet Community Maps Project, CC BY 2.5 India. Current member names © Karnataka Legislative Assembly.
